compatibility.notes: Recon is the public capability name for the existing Wayfind/Wayfinding lineage; aliases preserve discoverability without ID churn.

do_not_use_when.text: The full route can be settled in one session via Pressure Test or ordinary planning
The work is a bounded implementation slice already covered by Resume or Plan

use_when.text: The destination is visible but the route contains dependent uncertainty that exceeds one reliable planning session
The effort will benefit from a durable low-resolution map plus primary-source preservation across multiple sessions

evidence_outputs.description: Durable low-resolution map of the effort and current frontier.
evidence_outputs.name: wayfinding_map

evidence_outputs.description: Focused decision evidence that can update the map without duplicating full reasoning.
evidence_outputs.name: decision_resolution

inputs.description: Meaningful destination that bounds the effort.
inputs.name: destination

inputs.description: Existing Wayfinding map or durable decision state to continue.
inputs.name: existing_map

inputs.description: Repository truth, domain language, prior decisions, and evidence relevant to the map.
inputs.name: project_context

outputs.description: Destination, decision nodes, fog, out-of-scope areas, and current frontier.
outputs.name: wayfinding_map

outputs.description: Durable resolution for the focused node when walking an existing map.
outputs.name: resolution_record

preconditions.description: Dependent uncertainty cannot be responsibly collapsed into one ordinary planning session.

capability.purpose: Map and progressively resolve a large or foggy effort whose dependent uncertainty exceeds one reliable planning session.

requirements.description: Destination, frontier, fog, blockers, and out-of-scope state are distinguishable.
Focused resolution records evidence, uncertainty, consequences, and unlocked or invalidated work.
